driver.text:
"""Retire only superseded task-owned staged libraries after packet-only replay."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import lzma
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path('/Users/dylan/.codex/worktrees/native-unary-workflows/shardloom-local-repo')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PACKET = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-time-grid-2026-10-29.json.xz'
DESTINATION = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-time-grid-2026-10-29-cleanup.json'
assert not DESTINATION.exists()


def identity(path):
    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.resolve() == path
    return {'bytes': path.stat().st_size,
            'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


packet_id = identity(PACKET)
packet = json.loads(lzma.decompress(PACKET.read_bytes()))
verifier = packet['files']['tools/record_grid_acceptance.py']
assert hashlib.sha256(verifier['text'].encode()).hexdigest() == verifier['sha256']


def replay():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='grid-packet-replay-', dir=OUT) as folder:
        helper = Path(folder) / 'verify.py'
        helper.write_text(verifier['text'])
        process = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, '-B', str(helper), '--verify', str(PACKET)],
            cwd=folder, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='', PYTHONNOUSERSITE='1'),
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90, check=True,
        )
        assert json.loads(process.stdout)['status'] == 'passed'
        return {'status': 'passed', 'returncode': process.returncode,
                'embedded_verifier_sha256': verifier['sha256'],
                'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(process.stdout.encode()).hexdigest()}


before = replay()
final = json.loads((OUT / 'grid-public-r6.json').read_text())
retained = {name: expected for name, expected in final['native_product_and_source_identity'].items()
            if name.endswith(('/_native.abi3.so', '/ci-native/shardloom', '/ci-native/lib_native.dylib'))}
assert len(retained) == 3
for name, expected in retained.items():
    assert identity(Path(name)) == expected

planned = []
for attempt in range(1, 6):
    path = OUT / f'grid-public-r{attempt}' / '_native.abi3.so'
    report_name = f'grid-public-r{attempt}.json'
    report = json.loads(packet['files'][report_name]['text'])
    expected = report['native_product_and_source_identity'][str(path)]
    assert identity(path) == expected
    planned.append((path, expected, report_name))

handle_check = subprocess.run(
    ['/usr/sbin/lsof', '-nP', '--', *(str(path) for path, _, _ in planned)],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
)
assert handle_check.returncode == 1 and not handle_check.stdout and not handle_check.stderr

removed = []
for path, expected, report_name in planned:
    assert identity(path) == expected
    path.unlink()
    assert not path.exists()
    removed.append({'path': str(path), **expected, 'source_report_member': report_name})
    if not any(path.parent.iterdir()):
        path.parent.rmdir()
for name, expected in retained.items():
    assert identity(Path(name)) == expected
assert identity(PACKET) == packet_id
after = replay()
source = Path(__file__).read_text()
record = {
    'schema_version': 'shardloom.native_time_grid_cleanup.v1', 'status': 'passed',
    'scope': 'Five superseded task-owned staged libraries only; compact outcomes and final products retained.',
    'packet': {'path': str(PACKET.relative_to(ROOT)), **packet_id},
    'packet_only_replay_before': before, 'packet_only_replay_after': after,
    'closed_handle_check': {'returncode': handle_check.returncode, 'stdout_empty': True, 'stderr_empty': True},
    'identities_verified_before_and_immediately_before_removal': True,
    'removed': removed, 'removed_bytes': sum(row['bytes'] for row in removed),
    'retained_product_identities_verified_before_and_after': retained,
    'payload_backup_created': False, 'storage_limits_changed': False,
    'driver': {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(), 'text': source},
}
with DESTINATION.open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(record, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': 'passed', 'removed_files': len(removed),
                  'removed_bytes': record['removed_bytes'], 'packet_only_replay': 'passed'}))
